name: GM - Lansing Regional Stamping, Delta Township MI

fieldNotes.facility: Lansing Regional Stamping (LRS) is the large stamping building forming the southern half of GM's Lansing Delta Township (LDT) complex off 8400 Millett Hwy, Delta Township MI. The address-supplied/aggregator coords (42.7361, -84.5838) are wrong; the real complex is at ~42.687, -84.680, positively identified by the matching 3.6M-sq-ft twin-building layout on Millett Hwy west of I-69/I-96, with the boulevard security entrance and shared truck courts visible in imagery. LRS shares the controlled-access campus with LDT Assembly to its north.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single divided-boulevard main entrance off Millett Hwy. Street View (2021/2023) up the boulevard shows perimeter chain-link fencing along the approach and a low gate/security plaza structure spanning the entrance ahead. A teal-canopied guard/gate structure sits beside the secured access drive (visible in z19 satellite at ~42.6837,-84.6810).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Teal-canopied booth structure beside the secured entrance drive plus the gate/security plaza at the head of the boulevard; consistent with a staffed guarded entry standard for a GM assembly/stamping campus.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long divided boulevard from Millett Hwy to the buildings (several hundred feet of approach) easily holds a queue of 3+ trucks before reaching docks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck courts inside the gate between the stamping and assembly buildings provide holding/queue room before the dock banks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Divided boulevard entrance with wide paved aprons and multiple lanes leaves clear room to add a dedicated truck/express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks distributed across the shared truck courts (north court between LDT Assembly and LRS shows trailers backed into door banks; west court of LRS shows additional apron/doors). 25-50 band is an overhead estimate across the stamping building faces; total complex docks are higher.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of staged/dropped trailers in the north shared court and trailers in the west LRS court; estimated 10-25 dropped trailers, capacity ~50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Raw coiled steel is received at one end and stampings ship from another; receiving and shipping dock clusters sit on physically distinct building faces (north court vs west court).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: LRS stamping building plus the adjacent LDT Assembly plant and connector/body structures share the same secured property (~320 developed acres).
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur was clearly seen entering the developed footprint in the captured imagery; a rail line runs east of the site beyond the employee parking but does not visibly serve the docks. Left uncertain/false pending better imagery.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town/farmland setting in Delta Township west of Lansing; surrounded by agricultural fields and wetland on a ~1,100-acre parcel. Classified Rural per rubric (small-town-industrial leans Rural).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad clearly identified in imagery; left false/uncertain.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Boulevard gate/security plaza is the clear first checkpoint; a distinct second post-gate checkpoint was not unambiguously confirmed, so multiStep left false.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Divided boulevard reads as ~2 inbound / ~2 outbound lanes; exact count estimated.
